$comment: cmdc settings.json — bridge to .devin + .opencode + HLK harness. Schema: commandcode.ai/docs/reference/cli. Hardened 2026-08-27 theo commandcode.ai/docs/security (disableBypass, sensitive paths, MCP allowlist, skill shell execution).
$skillShellNote: Block !cmd inline + ```! fenced shell trong SKILL.md. Skill chỉ đọc file, không exec. Tăng cường supply-chain safety.
$onDemandNote: Shell prompt chỉ generate explanation khi user nhấn ctrl+e. Mặc định = on; tắt = mọi shell command đều explain upfront (token expensive).
$scratchpadNote: Session scratchpad BẬT. Mỗi session có /tmp/commandcode-<uid>/<cwd>/<session-id>/scratchpad, exposed as $COMMANDCODE_SCRATCHPAD env. Silent access (no prompt). Shared with sub-agents. Survives compaction. Cleaned after 30d.
$compactNote: Auto-compact when context approaches limit. Manual: /compact. Compaction append-only (transcript tree preserved, /tree can reach everything).

permissions.$bypassNote: Block --yolo + --dangerously-skip-permissions. Enforced ở mọi layer (engine, CLI entry, TUI mode cycle). Best practice: đặt ở settings.json này (project). User-global đã có thể đặt ở ~/.commandcode/settings.json.
permissions.$addDirNote: Đã ở workspace; liệt kê tường minh để audit rõ ràng. Skill dirs registered qua skills.paths tự grant.

permissions.$mcpAllowlistNote: MCP tool phải allowlist cụ thể (theo docs: 'bare * / mcp__* is not fine trong allow'). aide-memory chỉ dùng 5 tool recall/remember/search/update/forget; ruflo-hlk-mcp giữ wildcard vì chưa biết tool list cụ thể (sẽ narrow sau khi /mcp liệt kê). HLK reads là allow riêng qua Read rule, không qua MCP allow.
permissions.$askNote: Network egress (WebFetch/WebSearch) + runtime exec (node/npx/python -c) → ASK theo default. Tighter hơn docs default; an toàn hơn cho task thật. /add-dir outside workspace sẽ ASK theo external-dir gate mặc định.
permissions.$denyNote: Coverage (theo docs commandcode.ai/docs/security §sensitive-paths + §circuit-breaker): filesystem root/home; secret material (.env, .env.*, *.pem, *.key, id_rsa, ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, ~/.gnupg, ~/.kube); persistence vectors (.bashrc, .zshrc, .profile, .gitconfig, .gitmodules, .mcp.json); control surfaces (.git/**, .commandcode settings); HLK config/wrappers/bin/security/custom-hooks. Edit(.commandcode/settings.json) deny theo guidance 'persistence vector'.
